853:t_80:12.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「What world is he talking about with those combat techniques beyond mere skill, elevated to art, that he always mentions...?」

853:t_81:4.en:
$$葵$$
「Since we're here, I'll accept those words on behalf of all of $$チームＤ$$.」

853:t_81:6.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Happy Ace Pilot! Congratulations, $$葵$$, $$くらら$$, $$サクヤ$$, $$ジョニー$$, and $$エイーダ$$!」

853:t_81:8.en:
$$朔哉$$
「Since we've only been deploying combined lately, we've been pretty easy to overlook...」

853:t_81:9.en:
$$ジョニー$$
「But we're part of $$チームＤ$$ too.」

853:t_81:10.en:
$$エイーダ$$
「We all won this ace pilot title together.」

853:t_81:11.en:
$$葵$$
「That's right. Shall we have a party today?」

853:t_81:13.en:
$$ジョニー$$
「Then I'll show off my cooking skills for the first time in a while.」

853:t_81:15.en:
$$朔哉$$
「Well, well... I'm already full from watching you lovebirds, before we've even eaten...」

853:t_81:17.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Um... Aren't you going to invite me to that party...?」

853:t_82:5.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Your drill is in top form as always, $$シモン$$.」

853:t_82:6.en:
$$シモン$$
「Flatter me all you like, but I'm not doing any more kanji drills, math drills, or mandrills.」

853:t_82:7.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「No, no... This time, here is the drill I've prepared for you, $$シモン$$.」

853:t_82:9.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「The egg wash brushed onto baked goods like bread to give the surface a shine is called 'dorure.'」

853:t_82:10.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Now, $$シモン$$! How will you conquer this dorure!?」

853:t_82:11.en:
$$シモン$$
「There's nothing to conquer. It's food, so I'll just eat it. Here goes.」

853:t_82:12.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Ah...! My snack vanished in an instant...!」

853:t_82:14.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「What on earth... was I trying to accomplish...?」

853:t_83:4.en:
$$ヨーコ$$
「That's close enough, $$ＡＧ$$. Come any closer and I'll make you a target for my rifle.」

853:t_83:9.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Um... I'm already so far away that I can barely see your face...」

853:t_83:10.en:
$$ヨーコ$$
「For safety, I'll have you move right to the edge of my rifle's range.」

853:t_83:11.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「What!? That means you're telling me to get off the ship!」

853:t_84:4.en:
$$ギミー$$
「I'm starting to look the part of $$大グレン団$$'s assault leader, right?」

853:t_84:5.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「You are. Now if you master a drill like $$シモン$$, you'll be perfect.」

853:t_84:6.en:
$$ギミー$$
「But the $$ガンマール$$ doesn't have a drill.」

853:t_84:7.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「I thought you'd say that, so I've prepared one right here.」

853:t_84:8.en:
$$ギミー$$
「You prepared...! This is a monkey!」

853:t_84:9.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「This animal is a mandrill. $$シモン$$ mastered it too.」

853:t_84:10.en:
$$ギミー$$
「Then I'll do it! I'll catch up to $$シモン$$ and overtake him! I won't lose!」

853:t_84:11.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
(With that spirit, you'll grow even further, $$ギミー$$. I can guarantee that.)

853:t_85:5.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Your smile is so lovely... You're growing from a girl into a grown woman, $$ダリー$$.」

853:t_85:7.en:
$$ダリー$$
「If you come any closer, I'll shoot!」

853:t_85:9.en:
$$ダリー$$
「$$ヨーコ$$ and everyone told me to firmly drive you back if you came grinning toward me, $$ＡＧ$$.」

853:t_85:10.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Ah... Seeing your growth even in this leaves me unsure whether to be happy or sad...」

853:t_85:11.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「I feel like a father whose daughter refuses to bathe with him...」

853:t_85:12.en:
$$ダリー$$
「Please don't say creepy things like that!」

853:t_86:5.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「You've been doing wonderfully lately, $$シンジ$$. Isn't the position of $c's ace coming within reach now?」

853:t_86:6.en:
$$シンジ$$
「That's not true. I'm nobody special.」

853:t_86:7.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「You're so modest. But I, $$ＡＧ$$, look forward to seeing you keep growing, $$シンジ$$.」

853:t_86:8.en:
$$シンジ$$
「Thank you. I... intend to do everything I can, too.」

853:t_86:9.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
(If he keeps growing up so honest and straightforward, what kind of adult will $$シンジ$$ become...?)

853:t_87:5.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「You've been doing wonderfully lately, $$シンジ$$. Isn't the position of $c's ace coming within reach now?」

853:t_87:6.en:
$$シンジ$$
「That's not true. I'm nobody special...」

853:t_87:7.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「You're so modest. But I, $$ＡＧ$$, look forward to seeing you keep growing, $$シンジ$$.」

853:t_87:8.en:
$$シンジ$$
「Thank you. I... intend to do everything I can, too.」

853:t_87:9.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
(If the $$サードインパクト$$ hadn't happened then, how would $$シンジ$$ have grown up...?)

853:t_87:10.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
(Even I have no way of knowing what fate awaits you. But I look forward to seeing where it leads...)

853:t_88:4.en:
$$アスカ$$
「Oh... So my kill count passed 80...」

853:t_88:5.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「You're so cool about it... You really are an adult.」

853:t_88:7.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Please don't underestimate a dimensional trader's information network.」

853:t_88:8.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Still, I don't intend to tell anyone.」

853:t_88:10.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「I could hardly make light of the weight of your long years of battle, $$アスカ$$.」
